usage: Zi2sik1 (purple) is used to describe a specific color.
It can function as a noun to name the color purple in conversation.
Zi2sik1 is often used when talking about clothes, art, or objects to specify their color.
You can use zi2sik1 before nouns to describe the color of an item (e.g., zi2sik1 saam1 紫色衫 - purple shirt).
Zi2sik1 can also be combined with other color words for more detailed descriptions.
